calls.title: Growthbook <> English Gurukul - Demo
calls.summary:
We need to summarize the sales call transcript in 2-3 sentences. Focus on: what was discussed (product, features, pain points), key participants and their roles, next steps/action items.

Key participants: Poornima Siddabattuni (technical head, English Gurukul), Sameer Rather (senior backend engineer), Daniel Wathne (sales, GrowthBook), Graham (co-founder, GrowthBook).

What discussed: English Gurukul needs feature flagging and experimentation platform. They currently use Firebase but lacking evaluation/gradual rollout. Pain points: need to monetize via ads, test placements/colors, use AI agents. GrowthBook demo shows feature flags, gradual rollouts, experiments with BigQuery integration. Discussed Unity SDK and persistence. Next steps: Daniel to send documentation on Unity SDK and remote evaluation. Poornima and team will review and decide on next steps soon, aiming to start first experiment this week. Also discussed pricing (pro vs enterprise). 

Summary: During the demo, English Gurukul's technical head Poornima and backend engineer Sameer discussed their need for a feature flagging and experimentation platform to replace Firebase, which lacks gradual rollout and evaluation capabilities for monetizing ads and testing UI changes. GrowthBook's co-founder Graham demonstrated the platform's integration with BigQuery, safe rollouts, and experimentation features.
